shellCommands.command: ls -la app __agent_eval__ && cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json && ls __agent_eval__/

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; echo "--- next/server exports ---"; grep -o "connection" node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "--- server.d.ts ---"; cat node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo "=== TSC OK ===" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -35

npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
SRV=$!
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3111 -o /dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
echo "--- request 1 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "--- request 2 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "--- request 3 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
echo "--- cache header ---"; curl -sI http://localhost:3111 | grep -i 'cache-control'
kill $SRV 2>/dev/null
git status --short && echo "--- gitignore ---" && cat .gitignore && echo "--- tsconfig diff ---" && git diff tsconfig.json
